exposure: dietary restrictions during pregnancy and lactation
maternal diet during pregnancy and breastfeeding
cohort: The study included 72 Thai children with food allergy (cases) and 145 controls without food allergy.
finding: Term birth was identified as a protective factor, while personal atopic dermatitis and a family history of allergic disease were identified as significant risk factors for developing food allergy among Thai children.
mod_finding: Food allergy was unrelated to cesarean section.
